name: Tsukimori Masako
source:
The current head of Tsukimori household and grandmother of Aimi and Yumeno.

Masako substantially reigns as the village's chief, she is calm and cold-hearted at all times. For the sake of the village she won't hesitate to sacrifice her own relatives.

She becomes sixty next year.
